title: Cardmember Fitting Credit — Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards Benefit Bulletin for Alterations
content:
Holders of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards receive a cardmember fitting credit, taken off a Marlowe & Finch Alterations extra fitting fee:

| Card accounts the customer holds | Cardmember fitting credit |
|---|---|
| An active Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard account | 3.00 USD |
| Active Marlowe & Finch card accounts, none of which is one of those two | 1.00 USD |
| No active Marlowe & Finch card account | none |

**Records read.** The customer's card accounts: which card each is and whether its status is active.

## Combinations

| Accounts held (status) | Credit |
|---|---|
| Store Card Elite (active) | 3.00 USD |
| World Elite Mastercard (active) and Store Card (active) | 3.00 USD |
| Store Card Plus (active) | 1.00 USD |
| Mastercard (active) and Store Card Elite (closed) | 1.00 USD |
| Store Card Elite (closed) only | none |
| No card account | none |
